steps.title: S = scale·QKᵀ: address one head in BNHD
Row softmax with causal mask, and LSE

cases.name: single
cases.purpose: N = 1: only one key, P = 1, O = V, LSE = S. Checks the bounds checks at the smallest size.

cases.name: position_causal
cases.purpose: V[j] = j/N, N not a multiple of 32/64: a reversed mask direction or a wrong K/V row offset shifts the values of O directly.

cases.name: bnhd
cases.purpose: B and H both greater than 1: treating [B,N,H,D] as [B,H,N,D] (row stride D instead of H·D) fails here.

cases.name: bnhd_causal
cases.purpose: D = 128, causal, B·H = 6: checks that the head offset, two GEMM tiles along D, and the mask work together.

cases.name: scale
cases.purpose: D = 32, scale = 0.3 instead of 1/√D: checks that scale comes from p.scale and is not hard-coded.

cases.name: uniform_causal
cases.purpose: Q = 0: visible keys have equal weights, O is the mean of the first i+1 rows of V, LSE = ln(i+1). Checks the mask length and the normalization.

cases.name: ones_v
cases.purpose: V = 1: O must be 1 everywhere. Catches rows of P that do not sum to 1 (missing division by l, masked positions not written as 0).

cases.name: large_logits
cases.purpose: Q scaled up 8 times and scale = 1, so more than 90% of the rows have a maximum score above 88.7: FP32 exp(x) overflows to inf when x > 88.7, and a softmax that does not subtract the maximum gets inf/NaN.

cases.name: medium
cases.purpose: Medium size, non-causal, N = 513: several GEMM tiles and tail tiles.

cases.name: medium_causal
cases.purpose: Medium-size causal, N = 1000: each softmax thread covers several elements, and the mask length changes from row to row.

cases.name: n1k
cases.purpose: For performance comparison: S is 64 MiB in total and fits in the 126 MB L2. Look at it together with n2k and perf to see how time changes with N.

cases.name: n2k
cases.purpose: For performance comparison: S is 256 MiB in total, larger than L2.

cases.name: perf
cases.purpose: S is 1 GiB in total: the HBM traffic of S/P is 64 times that of Q/K/V/O.

cases.name: perf_causal
cases.purpose: causal: the standard implementation still computes, reads and writes the full N×N matrix, while the library computes only half.
